nom: The Ordinary Vitamin C Suspension 23% + HA Spheres 2% Serum with Pure L-Ascorbic Acid

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin who tried it report the serum's greasy after-feel reads as pleasantly dewy and moisturizing on their skin rather than problematic, including one who finally found the day-to-day moisture balance she had been struggling with.
segments.sensitive: The few reviewers who self-identify as having sensitive skin report the serum works for them when diluted with a generous amount of moisturizer and used sparingly, avoiding irritation while still getting the brightening effect.
segments.mature: Two reviewers, one over 70, credit the serum with keeping their mature skin free of visible lines and wrinkles, describing it as 'magic' for mature skin.

concerns.spots: Many reviewers use this specifically to fade dark spots, melasma, acne scars, and post-inflammatory marks, reporting visible lightening within one to several weeks of consistent, often twice-weekly, night use. A few report no visible improvement in their skin at all, even after weeks of use.
concerns.oiliness: The most common complaint is that the serum feels heavy, greasy, or oily and sits on the skin rather than absorbing, with several describing an oil-slick finish unsuitable for wear under makeup. Reviewers with dry skin report the opposite: the same greasy feel reads as a dewy, moisturizing finish they enjoy rather than a problem.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers, including one who does not consider her own skin sensitive, report their face turning red and burning within minutes of application, in one case fearing a chemical burn on the neck. One long-term user reports the opposite: a noticeable reduction in facial redness with continued use.
concerns.blemishes: A few reviewers report the serum broke them out or should be avoided on active acne and open blemishes, while one credits mixing it into a broader routine with ending her recurring monthly breakouts.
concerns.dehydration: One reviewer describes the serum as irritating and drying even after diluting it with moisturizer. Others who layer it with a moisturizer or hyaluronic acid serum instead report their skin feels well hydrated, even dewy, the next morning.
concerns.aging: Reviewers using the serum as part of a longer routine report firmer, more vibrant skin and softened fine lines, including one in her seventies who reports no visible lines or wrinkles. No reviewer in this set reports the serum failing specifically on wrinkles or firmness, though several report seeing no result from the product at all.

aspects.libelle: Gritty, sand-like texture many find abrasive
Strong smell many describe as chemical or unpleasant
Pills or balls up under moisturizer or makeup
Runny formula, hard to dose without a pump
Some bottles arrive underfilled or leaking
Very affordable for a high-strength vitamin C

extraits.titre: Great product so worth it love it…but
extraits.texte: I am giving this one star so only complain about the packaging ugh it's so bad. This is a runny product and it's very hard to regulate how much you get out. You will waist because it runs out. I would love them to put this in a dropper bottle or a bottle or tube with a pump on it. Please!!!! Change this packaging! This product does sting but it says it will it is just magic for mature skin. Love it.

I do not classify myself as having sensitive skin, it's rare that anything I use causes the reaction I had after using this. I'm a licensed esthetician in multiple states in the US and have recommend this brand to so many people. but this product is AWFUL. The smell alone made me dislike it at first. Then the sand like texture. If that wasn't enough, once I applied it, my face almost instantly turned red and started to burn. Unfortunately, I also applied it to my neck and I'm pretty sure I'll have a chemical burn there in the morning. I read what to avoid when using this and therefore only applied it to a clean, dry face. I only had it on for a few minutes before I had to wash it off and

I really wish I could love this product because I do feel like it has positive results. I have dry-ish skin, so the "greasy" feeling everyone describes, is more of a dewy and moisturizing feeling for me. The negatives of course are the grittiness and inability to blend well across the face. I mix with moisturizer to thin it out and it still pills up. If putting makeup on overtop, beware of the "peeling" effect this product gives which looks like your skin is peeling from a sunburn where the product doesn't absorb. The smell is quite terrible as well. Takes so getting used to bc I hate thinking my face smells all day. I don't think I'll re-buy after this bottle runs out because of all the negatives.

I've been using this product for about 3 months now. There is a trick to using it. It is VERY strong and WILL burn if you have sensitive skin and open acne flares. you do NOT want to put this where your glasses rest on your nose because it WILL burn your skin. The texture is gritty and works at exfoliating your skin. I would recommend just a simple cleanse before applying and then a moisturizer after. nothing else. it's not an every day product if you have other night time routines. you definitely don't want to do your makeup over this. If you do a mid-day routine you could do a stand alone treatment. Does this product work? absolutely. it will brighten your skin and leave it soft to the touch. since it's a bit abrasive, I'd suggest doing a gentle exfoliating treatment after to remove the dead skin that will come off after you've used it. It's also going to burn your skin off if you try to lay anything over it, whether it's your glasses or makeup. this product doesn't play well with anything else. If you can find a balance in your routine to use it then you'll be happy with the results. It has significantly reduced my dark spots and evened out the texture of my skin. It looks brighter and feels oh so soft.

This product is amazing. Yes it's gritty but it works. I'm a Black woman with lots of dark spots and struggle to manage them. This definitely helps lighten. My skin always looks much brighter in the morning after applying at night.

Ordinary products are great. It works. Noone believes my age. I also use pycnogenol and Noone in the store seems to know what it is. Love it along with argeline niacinamide 10 . Plus others. Works for me no lines or wrinkles at 73.

extraits.titre: Best Vitamin C serum that works!
extraits.texte: I don't understand all of the negative reviews, but I guess everyone's skin is different. In my experience: I've been using this product for a while now and after comparing it to other vitamin C serums, this is my holy grail for waking up with a bright complexion. Usually it takes a number of uses or a few weeks for a face serum to work effectively or to see results; but with this serum, you can literally see a big difference overnight! Although it is really potent and the texture can be a little gritty, you just have to know the proper way to use it. As a person with sensitive skin, I always make sure to mix a small pea sized amount of it with a lot of moisturizer so my skin won't get irritated.
